title: Eutris on his place in history
summary: She thinks he was among the greatest trombonists and is hurt that he can no longer play.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: How do you see or how would you like to see your brother in history, how do you see him? In his accomplishments.

I don't think he has accomplished as much as he was able to do because I thought he was one of the greatest trombone players in the whole world. I have never in my life heard anyone play like him. And I was so hurt and I'm still hurt that he's not able to play the trombone like he used to. Never have I heard anyone play a trombone like he my brother. It could be just you know just the way I feel but it's the difference. It's different altogether.
You're saying historically/you'd like speaking to see him go down as the greatest trombone player.
Yes, I would. I really would.
Well, I think the same thing. Of course, he can't just go on and on. After all, everybody gets older ... he's just about reaching the age where I think he should take it easy.
I don't think he should take it easy. I think he should get out there and try. I'm older than he is. I'm almost ten years older than he is.
You think that the inactivity would be bad for him?
I think he should just take it a little at a time, make an effort. EK: give instruction to younger people. .../
